name: Sound↔Light Cross-modal Mapping Hypothesis
claim: For some participants or cultural contexts, sound/music and light/brightness may form a salient bidirectional conceptual association; the modern phonetic resemblance between light and 籁 may strengthen that association.
not_claimed: sound physically becomes light in ordinary perception
the literary material is population-level psychological evidence
motivation: modern segmental resemblance: English /laɪt/ and Mandarin lài /laɪ̯⁵¹/
literary recurrence of eye↔ear, note↔ray, and music↔inner-light imagery
